title: Portland, OR — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Portland, OR: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Portland is a city in OR with a population of 635,067. Keep Portland Weird — craft beer, food trucks, and no sales tax in the rainy Pacific Northwest. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 144 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
